title: context_budget
description: The 3-tier context budget policy: which content classes must NEVER enter an agent's context window (VIP source full text, raw PDF originals, whole-chip databases, complete regression logs), which bounded fact artifacts are ALWAYS resident, and which are LOADED ON DEMAND. This is the machine-readable form of the rule -- dv_harness/context_budget.py is the only consumer that matters, and .claude/hooks/context-budget-guard.ps1 turns tier-1 into a real PreToolUse deny rather than a principle nobody enforces. Written as data (not hard-coded Python) so a project can extend the never-load set for its own DUT/VIP roots without editing harness code.

never_load.description: Tier 1. A tool call that would pull matching content into context is DENIED. Every rule must name a real alternative (mcp_redirect and/or distiller) -- a deny with no route forward is a dead end, not a budget.

always_resident.description: Tier 2. Bounded fact artifacts injected into every session by the SessionStart resident-pack hook (see context_budget.build_resident_pack).

load_on_demand.description: Tier 3. Real artifacts an agent may read, but only when a specific question needs them -- never preloaded.

exemptions.description: Audited, reasoned escape hatches from a never_load rule. An empty list is the correct default; each entry needs a real reason, in the same spirit as dv_harness/exemptions.py.

mcp.description: The fixed-verb query interface tier-1 denials redirect to.

reason.description: Why this content class blows the budget, in terms a denied agent can act on.

path_globs.description: Posix-style globs matched against a forward-slash-normalised, case-folded path. '**' spans directory separators; '*' does not.

allow_globs.description: Carve-outs checked BEFORE path_globs -- e.g. a distilled summary that lives under an otherwise-never-load root.

command_patterns.description: Python regexes matched against a Bash/PowerShell command string. Used for commands that pull content into context without naming a matchable path (e.g. pdftotext of a VIP user guide).

mcp_redirect.description: The fixed MCP verb that answers this content class instead. Null when no verb covers it and only a distiller does.

distiller.description: Repo-relative path to the real script that converts this content class into a bounded artifact.

alt_paths.description: Additional real locations searched, in order, when the canonical path is absent.

produced_by.description: The real generator/command that creates this artifact. Reported verbatim when the artifact is MISSING, so the gap is actionable rather than merely observed.

residency.description: How this artifact actually reaches context. 'harness_auto_load' is Claude Code's own project-CLAUDE.md behaviour; 'session_start_hook' is this policy's own resident-pack injection.

mcp_verb.description: Preferred fixed verb for targeted lookups into this artifact.

max_resident_bytes.description: Residency budget for this artifact: the pack summarises rather than inlines beyond this size.
